ports="22 80 443 3306 5432 8080 8443 9000 7001 8000 8081 9090 3389 5985 8082 8083 8084 8085 8086 8087 8088 8089 8090"
for ip in $hosts; do
  echo "Scanning $ip..."
  for port in $ports; do
    timeout 1 bash -c "cat < /dev/null > /dev/tcp/$ip/$port" 2>/dev/null && echo "  Port $port open"
  done
done
